verdict.rationale: Autumn ships an official, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants carry out billing actions, plan management, customer and balance operations, and request-log investigations, so users can operate it in natural language through an external assistant. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface in the dashboard or the `atmn` CLI, and the breadth and reliability of NL-driven operation is undocumented beyond the MCP overview. missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in product/CLI, detailed MCP tool coverage docs, hands-on or independent corroboration of NL operation.
